PROCEDURE ReadValues(BYREF Values : ARRAY, Count : INTEGER)
   DECLARE Value : REAL
   Count ← 0
   INPUT Value
   WHILE Value <> -1 AND Count < 100
      IF Value >= 0 THEN
         Count ← Count + 1
         Values[Count] ← Value
      ENDIF
      INPUT Value
   ENDWHILE
ENDPROCEDURE

FUNCTION CalculateAverage(Values : ARRAY, Count : INTEGER) RETURNS REAL
   DECLARE Index : INTEGER
   DECLARE Total : REAL
   Total ← 0.0
   FOR Index ← 1 TO Count
      Total ← Total + Values[Index]
   NEXT Index
   RETURN Total / Count
ENDFUNCTION

PROCEDURE DisplayResult(HasData : BOOLEAN, Average : REAL)
   IF HasData THEN
      OUTPUT Average
   ELSE
      OUTPUT "No data"
   ENDIF
ENDPROCEDURE

DECLARE Values : ARRAY[1:100] OF REAL
DECLARE Count : INTEGER
DECLARE Average : REAL
CALL ReadValues(Values, Count)
IF Count > 0 THEN
   Average ← CalculateAverage(Values, Count)
   CALL DisplayResult(TRUE, Average)
ELSE
   CALL DisplayResult(FALSE, 0.0)
ENDIF

PROCEDURE ReadValues(BYREF Values : ARRAY, Count : INTEGER)
   DECLARE Value : REAL
   Count ← 0
   INPUT Value
   WHILE Value <> -1 AND Count < 100
      IF Value >= 0 THEN
         Count ← Count + 1
         Values[Count] ← Value
      ENDIF
      INPUT Value
   ENDWHILE
ENDPROCEDURE

FUNCTION CalculateAverage(Values : ARRAY, Count : INTEGER) RETURNS REAL
   DECLARE Index : INTEGER
   DECLARE Total : REAL
   Total ← 0.0
   FOR Index ← 1 TO Count
      Total ← Total + Values[Index]
   NEXT Index
   RETURN Total / Count
ENDFUNCTION

PROCEDURE DisplayResult(HasData : BOOLEAN, Average : REAL)
   IF HasData THEN
      OUTPUT Average
   ELSE
      OUTPUT "Không có dữ liệu"
   ENDIF
ENDPROCEDURE

DECLARE Values : ARRAY[1:100] OF REAL
DECLARE Count : INTEGER
DECLARE Average : REAL
CALL ReadValues(Values, Count)
IF Count > 0 THEN
   Average ← CalculateAverage(Values, Count)
   CALL DisplayResult(TRUE, Average)
ELSE
   CALL DisplayResult(FALSE, 0.0)
ENDIF

description.en: Validate input and return the number of accepted values.

acceptedAlternatives.en: Accept technically equivalent wording or pseudocode that preserves the stated invariant and observable result.
